reviews.review_description: If you enjoy games like Deisim, Populus or Black & White you will love Warden of the Isles. It is a fun littly game which starts easy and get tricky pretty quick. You have to defend your realm against nasty attackers, managing troops and throwing mighty spells at enemies (or even throwing the enemies) - It is fun and you have to have good tactics to succeed. The game got a quirky humor which I love - For me a clear recommendation and more than fair at that price.

Having a blast with this. Aside from the fun of tossing enemies away to silly sound effects and voice lines, there's real strategic depth and awesome gameplay shenanigans to be had here. Skirmish is awesome when you see an enemy Warden grabbing your troops and hurling fireballs at you and there's genuine challenge to beat the enemy if you're after it. Multiplayer is a blast and it also has a great and fun narrative campaign.

reviews.review_title: I had to cancel my pre-order
reviews.review_description:
The game launched it stayed in the pre-order phase and then it stayed like that until today when I canceled my pre-order and bought the game for an extra $8,50. I don’t know if they’re aware of this or not but that’s why they are so few reviews, in my opinion. That’s the reason it’s down a star. Also selecting buildings takes multiple tries sometimes ￼before they’re selected.

Other than that, it’s a really fun game that I don’t regret buying

developer_response.body:
Wow! Thank you for bringing this to my attention. This is really a troubling thing to hear. I will need to get in touch with Meta to figure out what's going on. 
Thank you so much for sticking with it though and playing. So glad to hear you're enjoying it! Could you please email me and I'll be happy to send the $8.50 difference you had to pay if you can show me a receipt. Cheers and happy Goblin tossing!

reviews.review_description: It reminded me of tower defence games but with a fresh twist that only vr can give you. Grabbing enemies with your hand and throwing them to their doom is surprisingly rewarding or blasting them by throwing magic spells whilst running around to find the rest of the attacking forces
